headline: The biggest change in the property market in 30 years: many real estate developers are about to be eliminated!
summary: Reporting describes the biggest change in China's property market in 30 years, with many real estate developers expected to be eliminated amid shifts in pre-sale and completed-home segments.
why: China's property sector is a large share of the economy and a major driver of credit, commodities demand and banking exposure, so developer failures have wide economic effects.
